note: Patio season opens: a garden-wide fall festival, Dia de los Muertos, and a free Daniel Tiger meet-and-greet.

picks.reason: Free Daniel Tiger meet-and-greet at the Children's Museum — the weekend's biggest kid draw.
Great Fall Kickoff Festival opens the garden's best season with a full day outdoors.
Dia de los Muertos celebration at Burton Barr — the seasonal tradition starts now.
Fall Garden After Dark lights the Desert Botanical Garden for an evening wander.
Free Fall Butterflies — the garden's butterfly season at its peak.
Dino-themed enrichment day at the Phoenix Zoo — the animals meet their dinosaur toys.
Hispanic Heritage Month programming at the Children's Museum on Sunday morning.
Music in the Garden closes Sunday with Trailside Tunes at sunset.
